While the topics are mentioned, each is reduced to a single sentence or fragment. For example, the label warns that ZELVORAN may increase the risk of serious bacterial, fungal and viral infections and advises not initiating during active infection and interrupting if one develops; the piece says only "can lower your ability to fight infections. Tell your doctor if you have an infection." Interrupt treatment if a serious infection develops during use.' For tuberculosis: 'Your doctor will test for latent tuberculosis and may start you on preventive therapy.'
